behavior: Guarded construction of the AmbiConverter Conversion Mode parameter and its ordered direction labels
scope: One recovered complete nested VST3 component; not an installed or running Cubase application.

observation.conditional_contract: If the preceding initialization returns zero and the two label allocations/appends succeed, the recovered routine constructs one object with title Conversion Mode, identifier field 2, and two ordered UTF-16 labels: index 0 FuMa > AmbiX; index 1 AmbiX > FuMa.
observation.guard: 0x1509a8 calls thunk 0x14860; 0x1509ac skips the registration body when w0 is nonzero.
observation.identifier: 0x1509dc sets w2=2 before constructor thunk 0x1c65c; constructor 0x1c520 retains this argument and stores it at object+0x10 at instruction 0x1c604.
observation.title: 0x1509d4/0x1509d8 form UTF-16 title address 0x192308; constructor copies it into object+0x14.
observation.dispatch: Constructor stores vtable 0x1a03e0. Complete REA read of slot +0xd0 at 0x1a04b0 yields pointer 0x1c79c, agreeing with immutable source bytes.
observation.list_method: 0x1c79c copies the UTF-16 label and terminator, appends its pointer to the vector at object+0x338/+0x340/+0x348, then increments object+0x314 at 0x1c8d0-0x1c8d8. The constructor initializes that counter to -1 at 0x1c5f4-0x1c5f8, so two successful appends leave counter 1.
observation.ui_corroboration: The shipped .uidesc independently declares ConverterDirectionId=2 and segment-names FuMa > AmbiX,AmbiX > FuMa.

alternative_explanations: Unreferenced labels alone would not establish a parameter contract. Here label references, constructor writes, vtable slot bytes and the append implementation corroborate list construction.
A UI declaration could diverge from native registration. The resource tag and direction order agree with the recovered native body for this exact component.
A declaration can exist without being reached in a licensed runtime configuration. Reachability from a running Cubase instance has not been established.
disconfirming_checks_performed: Checked assembly argument registers and constructor store instead of accepting decompiler argument names as original symbols.
Resolved the virtual +0xd0 slot with a complete eight-byte REA analysis-memory read and compared it with immutable source bytes.
Inspected the callee and found ordered pointer append plus counter increment; it is not merely a label setter or replacement operation.
Inspected allocation-failure branch at 0x1c7d8: failed allocation returns without an append/counter increment, so the contract explicitly requires successful allocation.
Static codesign --verify --strict returned 0 for the recovered full component; this is on-disk signature/resource verification, not runtime trust or fidelity.
disconfirming_test: In a later authorized runtime study, query parameter identifier 2 and its reported choice labels/count; a different identifier, order or choice count would disconfirm applying this static construction path to that runtime configuration.

Before inferring DSP direction, trace parameter-2 consumers and use independent per-channel impulses in both modes; a label alone cannot establish permutation, gain coefficients, order limits or invertibility.
Repeat on x86_64 if a cross-architecture claim is required; this finding only covers arm64.
limitations: No Cubase or plugin process was launched; no audio, parameter automation or UI behavior was observed.
